diagnosis_question: What was the root cause of epistemic misclassification in WP-006?

investigated_causes.findings: PRIMARY CAUSE. Narrative synthesis in WP-006 blended source findings with architectural interpretation without maintaining an explicit sentence-by-sentence claim ledger.

CONTRIBUTING FACTOR. The existing Research API validates document/source/identifier integrity and path safety, but claim-level extraction and verification was performed in narrative markdown without an automated claim ledger verifier.

investigated_causes.cause: C. Schema Incapable of Representing Evidence
investigated_causes.findings: NOT THE CAUSE. The underlying schema (kad-research-corpus-v1, knowledge-plane EPISTEMIC_CLASSES) fully supports distinguishing SOURCE_FACT, DERIVED_SYNTHESIS, PROJECT_INFERENCE, and UNKNOWN.

remediation_strategy.immediate_fix: Authored deterministic claim-ledger.json and revised-synthesis.md with explicit claim-level provenance, locations, and verification statuses.
remediation_strategy.future_promotion_invariant: Before any research corpus is promoted to seed status in the governed KnowledgePlane, a deterministic claim ledger must be validated against primary source excerpts.
remediation_strategy.production_code_impact: Zero unnecessary code churn required; data and documentation models restored to full epistemic honesty.
